prompt: Your service's queries got 5× slower at 2 a.m. with no changes on your side. The same database cluster hosts another team's nightly batch job.
why: Someone else is consuming the shared resource. Isolate workloads or schedule the batch elsewhere.
trap: A change elsewhere matters, but the mechanism is shared capacity.

prompt: A VM's latency is erratic, and its CPU metrics show high "steal" time even though its own processes are mostly idle.
why: Steal time is the hypervisor giving CPU to other VMs on the host. Move to dedicated or larger instances.
trap: Low own usage plus high steal means someone else is using the CPU.

prompt: Disk latency on your Kubernetes pod spikes whenever a log-shipping pod scheduled on the same node starts compressing files.
tells: log-shipping pod scheduled on the same node
why: They share the node's disk bandwidth. Set resource limits, use separate volumes, or anti-affinity.
trap: Your pod's own usage didn't change; its neighbor's did.

prompt: In a multi-tenant API, every customer's latency rises whenever one large customer runs bulk imports.
tells: one large customer runs bulk imports
why: One tenant starves shared capacity. Add per-tenant quotas or isolated pools.
trap: It's not many clients at once; it's one heavy one.
